name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly during his university years, tinkering with a friend's beat-up Honda Civic for local amateur races. His knack for diagnosing and resolving complex mechanical issues quickly became apparent. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, Kenji joined a small Formula 3 team in Japan, where he honed his skills as a race engineer. His meticulous approach and ability to optimize car performance under pressure led to several successful seasons. 

Later, Kenji transitioned to sports car racing, seeking new challenges and broader technical scope. He spent several years with a prominent Japanese GT team before receiving an offer from Team WRT. Kenji is known for his data-driven methodology, prioritizing reliability and continuous improvement. He emphasizes clear communication and collaboration within the engineering team to maximize performance gains. His pragmatic approach to problem-solving and his focus on long-term strategic goals make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with slight thinning at the temples
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a serious demeanor and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every morning with a cup of strong green tea.
